definitionZh: 内置-内置-块大小 CSS 逻辑属性定义了一个元素的块大小,当该元素受到大小封装时,浏览器可以用于布局.
sourceDefinition: The contain-intrinsic-block-size CSS logical property defines the block size of an element that a browser can use for layout when the element is subject to size containment.
